title: security(rbac v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit hardening for data residency
author: Priya Singh
description: Motivation: enforce customer-configured KMS region residency constraints at the RBAC layer and harden audit logging for KMS-related operations. This PR implements KMS region pinning in RBAC v2, adds clear audit entries for residency decisions, and wires the feature behind a config flag so we can rollout gradually. Summary of changes: - Add region pinning policy predicates to RBAC v2 (allow/audit/enforce modes) - Integrate region checks into KMS request flow so requests violating residency are audited and optionally blocked - Enhance audit logs with residency fields: requested_region, kms_key_region, policy_residency_decision - Add config flag rbac.v2.kms_residency.mode (audit|enforce|off) and per-account overrides - Add unit/integration tests and update docs and helm values - Migration: default mode is audit. Ops can flip to enforce via feature flag. See rollout notes below. Checklist: [x] tests added/updated [x] docs updated [x] feature-flagged [x] CI green Links: internal Linear ENG-7842; support ticket SUP-1287; design doc: /docs/design/security/kms-region-residency.md
commits: 6 commits: 1) add kms_residency predicate and policy parsing; 2) wire residency check into RBAC evaluation path; 3) add audit logging hooks and serializers; 4) add feature flag handling and per-account override; 5) integration tests and mock kms responses; 6) docs + helm values and changelog
review_comments: Marcus Patel: Please ensure we don't add high-cardinality fields without sampling. Suggest adding residency fields under a nested 'residency' object in logs and marking kms_key_region as low-cardinality.
Priya Singh (author): Updated log serializer to add residency.* attributes and annotated kms_key_region as keyword/low-cardinality. Added test to validate fields are present.
Ava Chen: Integration tests look good. Can we add an e2e for a cross-region key to ensure audit-only mode does not block traffic?
Priya Singh: Added e2e test that simulates cross-region key and verifies audit entry is created but request proceeds in audit mode.
Elena Rodriguez: Lint failure on go vet initially - fixed. Also please call out the config migration steps in release notes.
Jon Kim: Approved after small nits addressed. Verified helm values change for private installer.
release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 gains KMS region pinning policy predicate. Administrators can require keys to be in the same region for certain operations.
Compliance: Enhanced audit logging for KMS operations includes requested_region, kms_key_region, and policy_residency_decision to aid residency investigations.
Operational: Feature is behind rbac.v2.kms_residency.mode (audit|enforce|off). Default = audit. To enable blocking behavior set to enforce at account-level via config or Linear rollout.
Upgrade notes: No DB migrations required. Update helm values (redwood-private.values.kmsResidency) to set defaults for private deployments. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for rollout steps.
notes_for_ops: Default behavior is 'audit' so existing requests are not blocked. To opt-in to enforcement set rbac.v2.kms_residency.mode=enforce in account config or via feature flag. Monitor residency.policy_decisions and residency.audit_events metrics before switching. If unexpected rejections occur, flip back to audit and inspect residency.audit_event entries. Contact infra-security on pager for incidents.
test_plan: Unit tests cover policy parsing and residency evaluation permutations. Integration tests exercise the RBAC decision path with mocked KMS responses for same-region and cross-region keys. E2E simulates a private deployment with a cross-region key to validate audit-only mode. CI runs all tests; manual verification in staging required before production enforce rollout.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge to main (audit mode default) 2) Deploy to staging and monitor residency.audit_events and error rates for 48h 3) Enable per-account enforce for a small pilot 4) Gradually ramp enforcement across accounts with alerts on increased 4xx rejections 5) Full enforcement after 2 weeks of pilot with no regressions
human_summary: Adds KMS region residency checks to RBAC v2 with audit-first rollout. Improves audit logs for investigations and exposes a config flag to opt into enforcement. Tested end-to-end and merged to main.
